source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne's NYM2 in Totowa, New Jersey, publishes 6 MW of IT capacity, 5.4% of the state's disclosed 111.3 MW, making it a minor node in a market where only five of 48 mapped data centers reveal power.

At 40 kW per rack, 6 MW is roughly 150 racks, a scale more consistent with colocation or inference than with large AI training clusters. The operator page does not break down workload or accelerator type, so the facility's AI role cannot be inferred from capacity alone.

New Jersey has 48 mapped data centers but only five publish power capacity, so the disclosed 111.3 MW is a floor. NYM2's 6 MW ranks fourth among the five reporting facilities. The 200,000 square feet of technical space suggests moderate density, but no grid connection or cooling details are published, leaving the binding constraint unclear.

The record includes no announced expansion, and the suitability score of 52 rests only on published IT capacity and operator type. It does not show whether this site can grow, nor whether New Jersey grid headroom would support additional load. SSAE 16 Type II certification addresses security and availability controls, not power or compute scaling.

suitability.basis: weighted mean of the published inputs named here, scaled to 100; formula on the methodology page
